description: High performance vector control drive, MEMOBUS/Modbus RTU on the built-in RS-485 port: run, frequency, torque and PID commands, status, fault and alarm words, output measurements
source: YASKAWA AC Drive A1000 High Performance Vector Control Drive Technical Manual, SIEP C710616 41H

sources.title: YASKAWA AC Drive A1000 High Performance Vector Control Drive Technical Manual
sources.note: MEMOBUS/Modbus data table (command data and monitor data)

notes: MEMOBUS/Modbus RTU: 8 data bits and 1 stop bit. Check the node address, baud rate and parity in H5-01 to H5-03 (factory address 1F hex).

To run from Modbus set b1-01 = 2 and b1-02 = 2. A parameter write takes effect after the Enter command (write 0 to 0x0900 to save to EEPROM, or 0x0910 for RAM only, depending on H5-11); command data needs no Enter command.
Only the command and monitor data are listed. Every parameter has its own MEMOBUS address in the parameter list of the manual: read it with function 03 and write it as above.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
